text: ① Non-Chinese citizens, with an age generally not exceeding 40 years old:② Information page, visa page or residence permit page of valid ordinary passport (required for students in China):③) Master's degree or above degree certificate or pre-graduation certificate, transcript (Those who submit the pre-graduation certificate must submit the original scanned copies of the master's degree certificate and transcript before enrollment):④ Language proficiency certificate (valid for 2 years, valid until September of the new term):(1) Chinese proficiency requirements for Chinese-taught majors:For science and engineering majors, a score of 180 in HSK Level 4 is required. Students majoring in liberal arts, economics and management, foreign languages, architecture, art, design and physical education should achieve a score of 180 in HSK Level 5.(2) Requirements for professional English proficiency taught in English:Toefl IBT80 or above, IELTS 6.0 or above (for students whose native language is not English), Duolingo English Test 112 or above or equivalent English proficiency certificates:Toefl Essentialsim Scores and Tob MyBestScores, etc. are acceptable.(3) High-level requirements for bilingual teaching professional language:For science and engineering majors, a score of 180 or above in HSK Level 4 is required; for economics and management majors, a score of 180 or above in HSK Level 5 is required.Broadcast IBT80 or above; Ielts 6.0 or above (for students whose native language is not English); Duolingo English Test score of 112 or above; Or equivalent English proficiency certificates;Toefl Essential SIS Scores and TOEFL MyBestScores are acceptable.
